rules.ruleText: Bow/warp beyond flatness spec pushes the surface outside high-NA depth-of-focus. Irreversible structural deformation: REJECT.
Resistance spike with organic signature is trace contamination. The wet bench strips it completely: REWORK (RCA clean).
Interface scattering below baseline mobility is parametric yield failure. No rework restores transconductance: REJECT.
STI center-line seam means sub-surface fill failure and inter-device leakage. Cannot be chemically extracted: REJECT / SCRAP.
Resistance spike with organic signature is trace contamination. The wet bench strips it completely: REWORK (RCA clean).
Keyhole void in the tungsten plug is an open circuit across backend metallization. Uncorrectable post-deposition: REJECT.
Titanium stringer shorts gate to source/drain, but C49-phase residue strips in the ultrasonic wash if caught early: REWORK (silicide etch).
